text:
incident-bot: @channel PagerDuty alert fired — service=embed-queue-prod | alert=high-5xx-rate | region=eu-west-1 | PD: PD12345

Jamie: I'm oncall, acked the PD. Starting triage. Checking autoscaler, KV cache and recent canary rollout. @Neha please standby.

Jamie: digging into pod logs now, running:
```
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/embed-queue-worker -l canary=true --tail=200 | grep -i "error\|oom"
```

Neha: I can jump on bridge if needed. Timezone: UTC+5. Will take over if Jamie needs to hand off.

Arlo: FYI saw this spike coincide with deploy model-serving:v2.4 ~ 13:22UTC. Suggest pausing canary or rollback.

Kevin: Pausing canary in infra console now.

ops-lead: What's the customer impact? CS team on it? @cs-bot any top-10 users affected?

cs-bot: Notifying CS, drafting message. Early telemetry shows ~12% 5xx on embed endpoint for last 10m; top affected customers: acme-co, fin-cap.

Jamie: Prelim: confirmed ~12% 5xx and p95 timeouts. Not a total outage but user-facing for embeddings. I'm going to attempt rollback of the canary to see if that reduces errors.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: acknowledged by Jamie.

Neha: Jamie handing off to me — I'll take bridge at 14:40UTC and continue triage. Quick notes: logs show repeated "kv cache miss" followed by worker OOM at p95. Runbook suggests restart pool + clear prefix cache: https://redwood.runbooks/embeds#kvcache

Jamie: Handoff done. Created follow-up ticket INF-789 and added initial timeline.

Arlo: Rollback applied for model-serving:v2.4 canary -> v2.3. Metrics: 5xx rate down 12% -> 3% in ~6m. Continue to monitor.

Kevin: Temp mitigation: scaled minReplicas 6 -> 4 to reduce pressure, command:
```
kubectl patch hpa embeds-hpa -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```

ops-lead: CS will send customer comms to top-10 now. No exec escalation at this time. We'll reassess in 15m.

Neha: On the bridge, attaching a short log snippet:
```
ERROR embed-worker: kv cache miss for prefix user-prompt-abc123
panic: runtime: out of memory
```

Jamie: Thanks. Tagging @Kevin to own memory cgroup follow-up. I'll draft the postmortem and link the deploy changelog.

Arlo: :thumbsup: If 5xx stays <=1% for 30m we can close PD. Reopen if it flares.

Neha: Monitoring — will update every 5m and post when PD can be closed.

cs-bot: Customer comms sent to acme-co & fin-cap with mitigation details.

Neha: PD incident candidate for close in ~27m if stable. Leaving notes/actions in INF-789.

Jamie: Closing note for thread: probable root cause is canary regression + increased memory pressure. Follow-ups: mem config adjustments, rollout gating, better kvcache metrics/alerts.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 acknowledged and under investigation.
